scenarios.prompt: Resolve one fall event using a versioned project cost rule and the landing surface or override state, then delegate recovery timing to landing-lag.

criteria.identity: Fall event, rule version, surface, and override IDs are explicit.
criteria.ownership: Fall cost resolves once while landing recovery timing remains in landing-lag.
criteria.evidence: Scripted position changes are labeled and cannot masquerade as natural fall evidence.
